explication: This repository is a curated directory of systematic- and quantitative-trading libraries, tools, projects, and learning resources—not a trading runtime. A reader searches the catalog, chooses a topic, and follows its listed resources; contributors can suggest additions or removals through pull requests. The README documents the major categories, while crypto has a separate focus page. The sampled Go, Python, and Rust programs are standalone language demos and do not implement the catalog workflow.
